records.issue_text: handleNewBooking.ts:1075 — `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)` is a silent no-op when evt.destinationCalendar is null, dropping non-organizer hosts' destination calendars for COLLECTIVE events — the exact case the PR is meant to fix
records.rationale: The diff sets `destinationCalendar: eventType.destinationCalendar ? [eventType.destinationCalendar] : organizerUser.destinationCalendar ? [organizerUser.destinationCalendar] : null` and then calls `evt.destinationCalendar?.push(...teamDestinationCalendars)`. When neither eventType nor organizer has a destination calendar, evt.destinationCalendar is null, so the optional-chained push is a silent no-op and teamDestinationCalendars (non-organizer COLLECTIVE hosts' calendars) are dropped — undermining the feature this PR adds.
